history.content: Hey there — good to see you. What’s been up today?
not much really. just kind of a long day. how do you even start with these things lol
We can start small — just whatever feels most present in the “long day” part, if anything. Or we can leave it vague for now, which is completely fine.

i guess... we had this family dinner sunday and my brother brought up that i still havent paid back the money my parents lent me. in front of everyone. i just felt so small. like im the screwup of the family
That sounds really small and exposed — like the dinner turned into a spotlight on you. Is it more hurt, shame, or both?
shame for sure. like everyone already thinks im behind, my younger brother has the house and the career and i'm just... not there. and he wasnt even being mean, thats the worst part. it was just true
That sounds harsh and very exposed — like the “just true” part made it sting even more. Does it make you want to hide, explain, or fix it somehow?
hide mostly. i kind of just want to not exist at those dinners. but it helped saying it out loud i think. gonna go to bed. thanks for listening
I’m glad you said it out loud, and we can leave it here for tonight. Sleep well.
